stamp.uploaded: Uploaded · it will show on every file
stamp.note: The signature and stamp you upload here go on every file the system produces (receipts, TCRs, account statements, journal entries and employee papers) when it's printed or saved as PDF. A PNG with a transparent background works best.
stamp.adminOnly: Only the Super Admin uploads the stamp and signature.

templates.entitiesNote: The logo shows at the top of the claim and the receipt; the bank details are written on the claim so the client can transfer to them.
templates.title: Templates
templates.wordsNote: Words between '{}' fill in by themselves: {words}. The stamp and signature are added at print time.

lists.note: Every list the screens show is edited here: what you add shows in the forms right away; what you remove disappears from new records only and old data stays as it is. Items with a lock are used in the system's calculations, so they can't be removed.
